### Look to the Creator - Truth for Life - June 8
Author: Alistair Begg (Truth For Life)
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-june-8.html
Passage: Numbers 11:23
Points:
- Moses succumbed to unbelief when faced with the immense challenge of feeding the wilderness multitude.
- He erred by looking to visible, created means rather than relying on the Creator's unlimited ability.
- God's promises never rely on feeble human power; He accomplishes what He speaks by His own omnipotence.
- Believers make the same mistake whenever they expect human strength to accomplish divine work.
- God confronts our doubts with the reminder that His hand is never too short to fulfill His word.

### When Moses’s Wish Came True
Author: Matt Foreman
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/article/moses-wish-came-true/
Passage: Numbers 11:29
Points:
- When Eldad and Medad prophesied in the camp, Moses responded with humility rather than territorial jealousy.
- Moses recognized the limits of external commands and longed for the Spirit to transform every person from within.
- His desire anticipated the great prophetic expectations of the coming Messianic era.
- This Old Testament longing was fulfilled through Jesus Christ and the outpouring of the Holy Spirit at Pentecost.
- Because all believers now share in the Spirit, Christians should advance the gospel joyfully without rivalry.
